text:
clare: Deploy-bot flagged a rising tail latency on canary v5.2.0 during the 8% staged rollout. Change window ends in ~50m. Asking for quick stop/go.

deploy-bot: [auto] Canary 8% -> p99 latency +420ms (baseline +40ms), request timeouts up from 0.03% -> 0.7%. Event ID c8e2a. No auto-rollback configured for this metric. See /deploy 20499 for full diff.

omar: any correlation with queue depth or decoder worker OOMs?

ree: checking traces now. Looks like decoder worker queueing spikes when embedding-service latency grows slightly. A few hosts hit worker saturation due to longer decode time for longer sequences.

infra-bot: [metric] decoder-pool-queue-length increased on canary nodes infer-dk-[4-7].region-eu-central. Memory is fine, CPU and GPU utilization at 85% on affected nodes.

maggie: if workers are saturated we should pause progression. Hold at 8% and avoid bumping until we either scale or enable a lighter decode path.

clare: agreed. Plan: pin rollout to v5.1.9-stable as a safety fallback, freeze traffic. Then two parallel mitigations: (1) scale decoder pool in canary cluster by +30% and (2) enable quantized-fast-decode feature flag for the new binary to reduce per-token latency.

clare: running: `rollout pin --deployment text-generation-canary --version v5.1.9-stable --by clare --reason "decoder queue spike -> p99 latency"`

deploy-bot: [action] Rollout pinned to v5.1.9-stable by clare at 6369998660. Canary traffic frozen at 8%.

omar: I'll trigger a scale and a rolling restart on the canary pool: `infra scale --pool decoder-canary --delta 30% --grace 60s`. ETA 10m.

ree: I'll toggle the feature flag on 15% of canary hosts first to smoke test quantized-fast-decode: `ff toggle quantized-fast-decode --env canary --pct 15`

product: hold other change windows for this service for the rest of the slot. We need a user-facing threshold to resume: p99 < +150ms and timeout <0.15% for rolling 20m.

maggie: adding rollout exit criteria to release notes: p99 < +150ms AND request-timeout <0.15% rolling 20m OR sustained CPU/GPU <90% on canary pool.

infra-bot: [update] scale job started at 6369998690. Rolling restarts initiated.

ree: ff toggle applied to 15% hosts. Initial smoke shows p95 improvement ~30ms and p99 improvement ~120ms on those nodes.

deploy-bot: [metric] overall p99 down to +250ms, timeouts 0.5%. Partial improvement but not yet within threshold.

omar: scale completed on decoder-canary, node count +32%. Warmup in progress. ETA another 5m to hit steady state.

clare: let's wait a 12m observation window after warmup. If metrics don't meet resume thresholds, we will either rollback the canary entirely or expand the quantized-fast-decode rollout. Vote: react with :+1: to wait, :-1: to rollback now, :eyes: to expand quantized flag now.

clare: votes?

maggie: :eyes: (lean expand quantized path to 40% while watching)

omar: :+1: (prefer wait 12m after warmup)

ree: :eyes: (can run canary-specific smoke at 40% FF)

product: :+1: (prefer wait but ok with cautious expansion)

deploy-bot: [action] Monitoring window extended 12m.

infra-bot: [metric] after scale + warmup: p99 now +170ms, timeouts 0.18%. Quantized hosts at 40% show p99 +110ms.

maggie: that's promising. Still slightly above timeout threshold. If quantized path at 40% keeps p99 < +150ms, we can unpin and continue a conservative bump to 12% with close manual oversight.

clare: decision: unpin blocked until thresholds satisfied. Next step: expand quantized-fast-decode to 60% of canary hosts and continue monitoring. If p99 < +150ms AND timeouts <0.15% for 20m, remove pin and resume incremental rollout.

ree: starting expansion: `ff toggle quantized-fast-decode --env canary --pct 60`

deploy-bot: [update] quantized-fast-decode expansion started at 6369998712.

infra-bot: [metric] after FF expansion: overall p99 +120ms, request timeouts 0.12%. CPU/GPU utilization stable ~82%.

product: thresholds met. Approve unpin and resume a cautious bump to 12% with manual gate.

clare: running: `rollout unpin --deployment text-generation-canary --by clare --reason "mitigation successful: thresholds met"`

deploy-bot: [action] Rollout unpinned by clare at 6369998720. Canary bump to 12% scheduled manual step.

omar: I'll continue to watch decoder pools and set auto-alerts for queue length >X and timeout >0.2%.

maggie: updating release notes with mitigation steps, the FF toggle, scaling action, and rollback criteria. Will include link to postmortem once drafted.

clare: thanks team. @ree @omar please add timeline and config diffs to the postmortem. We'll file RCA next shift. :thumbsup:
